# posst.app

> AI-powered social media posting for small businesses. Automated daily posts to Facebook and Instagram with AI-generated images and captions.

## Pricing
- Standard: A.99/month - daily AI posts to Facebook and Instagram
- Pro: A.99/month - all image styles, full branding, your own photos
- 30-day free trial on all plans
